curriculum.phase_a: prebought=random (phase-A generator armies, start in DEPLOY)

config.eval_policy: deterministic masked argmax over legal actions, canonical view, one episode per layout, no TTA (true score, never shaped)
config.note: Row (p) + row (cc) DDQN train_freq pilot, NON-GATING. ddqn = rl.ddqn.DDQN_CONFIG exactly; 'train_freq' of row (p) is the trainer flag --train-every (gradient updates per env steps: 1/4 vs 1/8). Shaping on in TRAINING envs only.

selection.metric: mean TUNE-val true score over t = 250k/275k/300k and both seeds per arm
